verdict.rationale: Cake documents option grants with NSO/ISO handling and automated board sign-off and e-signing flows. It also includes 409A valuations from appraisers within its plans. However, nothing shows the 409A result setting the option strike price, or the grant, approval and valuation steps running as one connected workflow. missing for 10: evidence that the 409A valuation feeds the strike price at grant time, documentation of a single end-to-end grant-to-approval flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
